articles.title: Cannot Log In – Troubleshooting Guide
articles.content: If you cannot log in, follow these steps: 1) Clear your browser cache and cookies. 2) Try a different browser or incognito mode. 3) Reset your password using the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. 4) Check whether your account is locked after repeated failed attempts – accounts lock after 5 failed attempts. 5) Ensure your subscription is active and not expired. 6) If the issue persists after these steps, contact support with your account email.

articles.title: Password Reset – Step by Step
articles.content: To reset your password: 1) Navigate to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. 2) Enter the email address associated with your account. 3) Check your inbox for a reset link (also check spam/junk). 4) The link expires after 30 minutes. 5) Set a new password of at least 12 characters including uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a special character. 6) If you do not receive the email within 5 minutes, contact support.

articles.title: Billing and Invoice Queries
articles.content: For billing and invoice queries: 1) Invoices are generated on the first day of each billing cycle and sent to the registered billing email. 2) You can download all invoices from Account Settings > Billing > Invoice History. 3) Payments are processed within 24 hours of the billing date. 4) For discrepancies or duplicate charges, raise a dispute via Settings > Billing > Raise Dispute – resolution takes 3–5 business days. 5) Refund requests are processed within 7–10 business days. 6) To update your payment method, go to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods.

articles.title: Subscription Plans – Features and Pricing
articles.content: Our plans: Basic Plan includes 5 users, 10 GB storage, standard support (48h SLA), core dashboard features, and CSV export. Pro Plan includes 25 users, 100 GB storage, priority support (8h SLA), advanced analytics, API access, and all integrations. Enterprise Plan includes unlimited users, unlimited storage, dedicated support (1h SLA), custom integrations, SSO, audit logs, and a dedicated account manager. Annual billing provides a 20% discount on all plans. Contact sales@example.com for enterprise pricing.

articles.title: Export Feature – Troubleshooting Server Errors
articles.content: If the export feature returns a server error: 1) Check the status page at status.example.com for ongoing incidents. 2) Ensure the date range selected is less than 12 months for large datasets. 3) Try exporting smaller data subsets first. 4) Clear your browser cache and try again. 5) Ensure your browser is up to date. 6) If the problem persists, collect the error code shown and the export parameters (date range, filters applied) and contact technical support.

articles.title: Feature Requests – How to Submit
articles.content: We welcome product feedback. To submit a feature request: 1) Navigate to Help > Feature Requests > Submit New Request. 2) Describe the feature and the problem it solves for your workflow. 3) You will receive a confirmation email with a reference ID. 4) Popular requests are reviewed by the Product team quarterly. 5) You can track the status of existing requests at feedback.example.com. 6) Features on the public roadmap are tagged 'Planned', 'In Progress', or 'Shipped'.

articles.title: Adding Team Members to Your Workspace
articles.content: To add team members: 1) Go to Settings > Team > Invite Members. 2) Enter the email addresses of the people you want to invite (comma-separated for multiple). 3) Assign roles: Admin (full access), Editor (create and edit), or Viewer (read only). 4) Invites expire after 72 hours – resend if needed. 5) The number of available seats depends on your plan. To add more seats, go to Settings > Billing > Manage Seats. 6) Admins can remove members from Settings > Team > Manage Members.

articles.title: API Authentication and Token Issues
articles.content: If your API token is being rejected: 1) Verify the token has not expired – tokens expire after 90 days by default. 2) Regenerate your API key from Settings > Developer > API Keys. 3) Ensure you are including the token in the Authorization header as 'Bearer YOUR_TOKEN'. 4) Check that your IP address is not blocked by your account's IP allowlist. 5) Confirm your plan includes API access (Pro and Enterprise plans only). 6) Review our API documentation at docs.example.com/api for correct request format.

articles.title: Compliance Certifications – SOC2 and ISO 27001
articles.content: Our platform maintains the following certifications: SOC 2 Type II (renewed annually, last audit: August 2024), ISO 27001 (Information Security Management, certified 2023), GDPR compliant (EU data processing), CCPA compliant (California Consumer Privacy Act). Compliance reports and security documentation are available to Enterprise customers via the Trust Portal. To request a copy of the latest audit report, contact compliance@example.com with your company name and use case.

articles.title: Cancelling Your Subscription
articles.content: To cancel your subscription: 1) Go to Settings > Billing > Manage Subscription > Cancel. 2) You will retain access until the end of the current billing period. 3) Data is retained for 30 days after cancellation for export. 4) Pro-rata refunds are issued for annual plans cancelled within the first 30 days. Monthly plans are non-refundable once the cycle has started. 5) You can re-activate your account within 30 days without losing data. 6) For enterprise cancellations, contact your account manager directly.
